exclusions.git_internals: All .git directories; objects/refs/hooks/info in detected bare repositories.
exclusions.symlinks: Listed but not followed or read to avoid escaping scope/duplicates.
exclusions.archive_limits: All inventoried outer and nested zip/tar containers were searched; three depth-3 fixture archives were completed in a supplemental pass. Individual text member cap64MiB; no members skipped for size. Dependency wheels, binary and SQLite archive members were not parsed as text.
exclusions.databases: SQLite opened mode=ro with query_only=ON; no imports of project code. .tempo/.tempo_old and all other detected project databases inspected.

db_user_speech_limit: Schemas include kickoff_record, custom_alignment, prompt_display and operation_payload, but no claim that generic stored context is authored user speech. Each matching DB cell retains table/column/row provenance. Main tempo session-log matches identify assistant output_preview fields.
date_note: Generated/completed timestamps are scan times. File mtimes are filesystem observations, not asserted authorship dates. Main tempo transcript matches are agent-turn-complete outputs dated2026-07-28.
main_root_note: Main-root counts describe filesystem location, including reference/input/source-package snapshots held beneath each root. They do not assert current executable reachability or file authorship. Variants/backups and archive-member copies are reported separately.
